tasks.label: Run repro no-session flow
tasks.command:
uv run --directory backend python -c "import asyncio, json, main
# Step 1: send initial message and get followup (no client session stored)
req1 = type('R', (), {'message':'pay 599 for moview tickets at pvr 3days back','session_data':None,'followup_field':None,'assumption_action':None,'edited_assumptions':None,'rejected_assumptions':None,'selected_assumption_options':None})
res1 = asyncio.get_event_loop().run_until_complete(main.chat(req1))
print('Initial response:', json.dumps(res1, indent=2))
# Step 2: user replies 'upi' but client sends no session_data
req2 = type('R', (), {'message':'upi','session_data':None,'followup_field':None,'assumption_action':None,'edited_assumptions':None,'rejected_assumptions':None,'selected_assumption_options':None})
res2 = asyncio.get_event_loop().run_until_complete(main.chat(req2))
print('After upi:', json.dumps(res2, indent=2))"
